# cat-harness-tools-adapters

The standalone MCP server (`adapters/mcp-server/`): its tool registrars, the declared tool groups that load them, and the Dockerfile that packages it. Moved from `cat-harness/adapters/mcp-server/` (bean `w2gr`, step 3a) because it is a server, and the owner ruled that tool implementations live here while their definitions stay in cat-harness.

Part of [C@T Harness Tools](../README.md) 0.1.0, declared as `cat-harness-tools-adapters`, holding `code`.
